lines.en: Every morning since my sex-life with a famous idol was reignited, there’s been a 30%% chance that I wake up beside her.
lines.zh: 自从我和一位著名偶像的性生活重燃以来,每天早上都有 30% 的概率,我会在她身边醒来。

lines.en: Today is not one of those days. Which is sad.
lines.zh: 今天不是。真遗憾。

lines.en: But it is also good because it means I get to do all of the things I can’t normally do while she’s still in here — like practice my kickboxing moves or grease the bearings of my secret skateboard.
lines.zh: 但这也是好事,因为这意味着我可以做所有她在时没法做的事——比如练习自由搏击动作,或者给我那块秘密滑板的轴承上油。

lines.en: I decide against doing any of that, though. And not just because I’m a liar either. It’s because I have a feeling I’m going to need to conserve my energy for when something bad happens today.
lines.zh: 不过我决定一样都不干。也不只是因为我是个骗子。而是我有种预感:今天等坏事发生时,我会需要省着点力气。

lines.en: After all, it’d be a real shame if I was too busy doing skateboard maintenance to stop the ghost of my departed first love from molesting another girl I know. Especially one as hot as Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 毕竟,如果我忙着保养滑板,没去阻止初恋亡灵骚扰我认识的另一个女孩,那可真够遗憾的。尤其是像 Tsuneyo 这种火辣的。

lines.en: That’s enough about Tsuneyo, though. Today is all about me. And if I’m going to practice this “self-care” thing I always hear Ami talking about, I shouldn’t be thinking about ethnically diverse bombshell teenagers.
lines.zh: 不过 Tsuneyo 就聊到这里。今天是属于我自己的日子。如果我要练习 Ami 总挂在嘴边的「自我关怀」,就不该想着那些族裔多元的火辣少女。

lines.en: I should be thinking about their breasts — which is a different thing entirely.
lines.zh: 我该想的是她们的胸——那是完全不同的另一回事。

lines.en: Now, please excuse me while I close the blinds and-
lines.zh: 好了,请容我拉上百叶窗,然后——

lines.en: : You don’t say? You know, I know an excellent lawyer. So if you need some assistance in the case your production company is building against you-
lines.zh: : 不是吧?你知道,我认识一位出色的律师。所以如果你的经纪公司正在对你立案,你需要一点协助——

lines.en: Oh no.
lines.zh: 哦不。

lines.en: How am I supposed to jerk off to this?
lines.zh: 这让我怎么撸?

lines.en: : Tsubasa, what are you doing here? I don’t remember putting my house on the market. But if Niki did, then I guess that’s fine because I need to win more points with her and Ami scares me now anyway.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,你来这里干什么?我不记得我家挂牌出售了。但如果是 Niki 挂的,那我想也行,毕竟我需要多攒点她的好感分,而 Ami 现在反正也吓人。

lines.en: : Ah, there you are. Your girlfriend here was just telling me all about your origin story together. It was all very exciting information that I definitely did not already have.
lines.zh: : 啊,你可算现身了。你这位女朋友正在给我讲你们的起源故事。都是些非常精彩的情报——我绝对早就知道的那种。

lines.en: : Niki, you didn’t look into her eyes, did you?
lines.zh: : Niki,你没看她的眼睛,对吧?

lines.en: : Nnnnnnnnnope.
: Good. Because that’s all it takes for her to gain control over someone. But I think where you’re looking right now might also do the trick, so chances are we’re both fucked.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为她只需那个,就能控制一个人。不过我想,你现在看的位置或许也能达到效果,所以我们俩多半都完了。

lines.en: : Oh, Akira. Once more, you fail to understand just how different your situation would be if I truly did control you.
lines.zh: : 哦,Akira。你又一次没能理解,如果我真的控制了你,你的处境会有多么不同。

lines.en: : If you figure it out, let me know. I’ve been trying to control him since before his eyes were all squiggly like that. I think he’s just allergic to affection.
lines.zh: : 你要是弄明白了,记得告诉我。从他眼睛还没长成那副扭曲样之前,我就一直在试图控制他。我觉得他只是对「爱」过敏。

lines.en: : Tsubasa, why are you even here? Because I don’t think giving my childhood friend legal advice is something on your endlessly packed to-do list.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,你到底为什么在这里?因为我不觉得给我青梅竹马提供法律咨询,会排在你那张永远爆满的待办清单上。

lines.en: : You’re absolutely correct. There are far too many instances of tormenting you on that list to make room for much else at all. I’m glad that you at least understand how busy I am, though.
lines.zh: : 你说得完全正确。那张单子上「折磨你」的条目实在太多,根本腾不出地方给别的。不过至少你明白我有多忙,我很欣慰。

lines.en: : Well, you wouldn’t be Tsubasa if you weren’t inserting yourself into every single aspect of my life.
lines.zh: : 嗯,要是不插手我生活的每一个层面,你也就不是 Tsubasa 了。

lines.en: : And you wouldn’t be Akira if you weren’t inserting yourself into every girl in your life. To think you’d bag a fucking Tsukioka, though? That’s-
lines.zh: : 而要是不插进你人生中每一个女孩,你也就不是 Akira 了。不过你居然搞上了一个天杀的 Tsukioka?那可是——

lines.en: : Now, hold on one moment. Akira has not bagged me at all. In fact, I’m one of the few remaining people in this city he has not yet slept with.
lines.zh: : 现在,稍等片刻。Akira 根本没有搞上我。实际上,我是这座城市里他尚未睡过的少数幸存者之一。

lines.en: : Impossible.
lines.zh: : 不可能。

lines.en: : I’m not the only one who caught the “yet” there, am I?
lines.zh: : 不是只有我抓到了刚才那个「尚未」,对吧?

lines.en: : He’s right. Disappointment is an inevitability with him. That “yet” is just foreshadowing.
lines.zh: : 他说得对。和他在一起,失望是必然的。那个「尚未」只是伏笔。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better, I might think you want me to sleep with him.
lines.zh: : 我要是无知一点,还以为你想让我和他睡呢。

lines.en: : How about an idol instead?
lines.zh: : 要不换个偶像?

lines.en: : Oh my.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : Niki, please don’t hit on any of the girls who come here to see me.
lines.zh: : Niki,请别对来见我的任何女孩搭讪。

lines.en: : Why not? It’s rare one enters that I can legally do that for. And if you’re going to cheat on me with an entire town, at least let me hook up with the rich lady out of spite. She knows a lawyer, Akira. And I’m in trouble.
lines.zh: : 为什么不行?难得进来一个我在法律上能这么做的。再说,你要跟整个镇子乱来,至少让我出于报复和这位富太太好一场。她认识律师,Akira。而我有麻烦了。

lines.en: : What’s going on out here? Is Aunt Niki trying to steal Touka’s mom from you as revenge for sleeping with the entire town?
lines.zh: : 外面怎么回事?Niki 阿姨是想从你手里抢走 Touka 的妈,报复你睡了整个镇子吗?

lines.en: : My fury knows no bounds.
lines.zh: : 我的怒火无边无际。

lines.en: : Why, if it isn’t Ami. That’s...quite the mug you have there.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,这不是 Ami 吗。你那……可真是个了不得的杯子。

lines.en: : What mug? I didn’t- oh my fucking God. Ami!
lines.zh: : 什么杯子?我没——我的天。Ami!

lines.en: : Thanks, Mrs. Tsukioka! I had it custom made. I got one for my dad too.
lines.zh: : 谢啦,Tsukioka 太太!我定制了它。也给我爸定了一个。

lines.en: : I don’t want it. And I don’t want you to have it either.
lines.zh: : 我不想要它。我也不想让你拥有它。

lines.en: : But Touka’s mom said it’s okay and she’s rich!
lines.zh: : 可是 Touka 的妈妈说没关系,而且她有钱!

lines.en: : SHE DID NOT SAY THAT! SHE JUST POINTED IT OUT!
lines.zh: : 她没说过那种话!她只是把它指出来了!

lines.en: : Frankly, I don’t see the issue so long as both parties consent. Incest dates back longer than any of us do and has been employed by nobility for thousands of years to keep bloodlines pure.
lines.zh: : 坦白讲,只要双方自愿,我看不出有什么问题。乱伦的历史比我们任何人都久,数千年来贵族一直用它保持血统纯正。

lines.en: : Don’t say things that will encourage her! She’s bad enough as-is!
lines.zh: : 别说会鼓励她的话!她已经够糟糕了!

lines.en: : You heard her, Dad. This is the only way to keep our bloodline pure.
lines.zh: : 听见了吧,爸。这是保持我们血统纯正的唯一方式。

lines.en: : Wow. She does really like you, doesn’t she? My girls have never so much as looked at their father that way.
lines.zh: : 哇。她是真的很喜欢你,是吧?我的女儿们可从没用那种眼神看过她们的父亲。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, your girls have probably only seen their father a handful of times. I’m not even sure he’s real, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那是因为你的女儿们大概只见过她们父亲几次。说实话,我都怀疑他是不是真实存在。

lines.en: : Perhaps you’d like to meet him? It would only be right in the event that our families start mixing gene pools.
lines.zh: : 或许你想见见他?毕竟若两个家族开始混合基因池,那也是应有之义。

lines.en: : That’s it! Everybody dump your coffee back into the pot! I wouldn’t have made shit if I’d known we were going to start talking about gene pools!
lines.zh: : 够了!所有人把咖啡倒回壶里!早知道要开始聊基因池,我根本不会做这玩意!

lines.en: : Oh, thank heavens. I was starting to worry that I was expected to drink this commoner swill.
lines.zh: : 哦,谢天谢地。我还开始担心,得让我喝这种平民泔水呢。

lines.en: : No offense, Nakayama-san. I do appreciate the gesture.
lines.zh: : 没有冒犯之意,Nakayama 桑。我确实领情。

lines.en: : You are not nearly as hot as I thought you were a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 你可远不如一分钟前我以为的那么火辣。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Aunt Niki. I’m kind of into it. And now that you’ve decided to throw away a fortune in exchange for love, I think this family might need to explore other options in terms of increasing our wealth.
lines.zh: : 这我可说不好,Niki 阿姨。我有点上头。而且既然你决定舍弃一笔巨款换爱情,我想这个家族可能得在增收方面探索别的选项了。

lines.en: : Merging with the Tsukiokas seems like a great way to tackle that. One that might even do away with the Arakawa pettanko gene once and for all.
lines.zh: : 与 Tsukioka 家联姻,看起来是解决此事的好办法。甚至可能一劳永逸地除掉 Arakawa 家的贫乳基因。

lines.en: : I should have just stayed in my room and fixed my skateboard...
lines.zh: : 我真该留在房间里修我的滑板……

lines.en: : And I should have trusted my gut by not allowing any woman I have not personally approved to set foot in my house.
lines.zh: : 而我该相信自己的直觉,不许任何未经我亲自批准的女人踏进我家。

lines.en: : Oh, was your name added to the deed? Because I’m pretty sure this house is just as much Touka’s mom’s as it is yours. Probably even more since her family basically owns Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 哦,房契上添了你的名字吗?因为我相当确定,这房子一半是 Touka 妈妈的,一半才是你的。甚至多半更多——毕竟她家基本上拥有 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : I don’t give a shit what she owns, how rich she is, or how awesome her boobs are. You don’t walk into the home of my Akira, tell him it’s okay to fuck his daughter, and then offer up some sort of...bloodline swap.
lines.zh: : 她拥有什么、多有钱、胸多棒,我他妈一概不在乎。你不能走进我家 Akira 的家,告诉他上他女儿没关系,然后抛出什么……血统交换。

lines.en: : You respect my boundaries, you respect my boyfriend, or you get out. Got it? Same goes for whatever apparent spawns of yours wind up crawling in here next too.
lines.zh: : 你要么尊重我的边界、尊重我的男友,要么滚出去。明白吗?你那些显然生出来的崽子要是接下来也爬进来,同样照办。

lines.en: : Uhh...Niki? As much as I appreciate this mother-bear side of you attempting to protect her den or whatever, Tsubasa is probably the last person you should speak to like that-
lines.zh: : 呃……Niki?虽然我很欣赏你护崽母熊的一面、试图保卫巢穴什么的,但 Tsubasa 大概是你最不该用那种口气说话的人——

lines.en: : I apologize. You are absolutely right and I was being inconsiderate after you went out of your way to extend a warm welcome to me. Please forgive me.
lines.zh: : 我道歉。你说得完全正确。你特意热情欢迎我,我却考虑不周。请原谅我。

lines.en: : Oh. What the fuck? How come you never stop doing things when I tell you to?
lines.zh: : 哦。什么鬼?为什么我叫你停的时候,你从来不停?

lines.en: : I enjoy playing with you. You’re the only toy I have that I can use in public without being put on a registry.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢和你玩。你是我唯一一件能在大庭广众之下使用、又不会被登记在册的玩具。

lines.en: : Yet, you are somehow not having sex.
lines.zh: : 可不知为何,你们居然没有在做爱。

lines.en: : Impossible.
lines.zh: : 不可能。

lines.en: : Right?! That’s exactly what I said!
lines.zh: : 对吧?!我就是这么说的!

lines.en: : Nakayama-san, would you permit me to borrow Akira for the rest of the day? On the condition of me continuing to not have sex with him, of course.
lines.zh: : Nakayama 桑,能否允许我借用 Akira 一天?条件当然是我继续不和他做爱。

lines.en: : No hand or mouth stuff either, right? I don’t want to agree if there’s going to be some sort of loophole you use to jerk him off in the parking lot.
lines.zh: : 手和嘴也不行,对吧?要是你打算钻空子,在停车场给他撸,我可不同意。

lines.en: : We don’t have a parking lot.
lines.zh: : 我们没有停车场。

lines.en: : I never specified that it had to be ours.
lines.zh: : 我可没说是我们家的停车场。

lines.en: : I won’t lay a finger on him. And if he lays one on me, I’ll have him executed on the spot. Does that work?
lines.zh: : 我一根手指都不会碰他。而他若碰我一根,我会让他当场正法。这样行吗?

lines.en: : Perfectly, actually. Just make sure you feed him and give him water before you bring him back. He gets annoying if you don’t.
lines.zh: : 完美,真的。不过带他回来之前,记得喂他、给他水喝。不然他会很烦人。

lines.en: : Ami, can you get me a cup of coffee? Niki still hasn’t poured me one and I’m about to get really annoying.
lines.zh: : Ami,能给我倒杯咖啡吗?Niki 到现在还没给我倒,我马上要变得非常烦人了。

lines.en: : Sure. You can have mine.
lines.zh: : 好。把我的给你。

lines.en: : Take a sip out of that mug and I swear to fucking God I will have the rich lady bring you back as a eunuch.
lines.zh: : 你敢用那个杯子喝一口,我对天发誓,我会让那位富太太把你变成太监带回来。

lines.en: : I suppose I can feed him. We have some kibble left over from when Tsukasa wanted a rabbit. Does that work for you, Akira?
lines.zh: : 我想我可以喂他。Tsukasa 想要养兔子的那阵,还剩了些宠物粮。这样可以吗,Akira?

lines.en: : I’m not in trouble again, am I?
lines.zh: : 我又惹麻烦了,是吗?

lines.en: : Do you think it is within my power to discipline you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,管教你在我的能力范围内吗?

lines.en: : Yes.
: Good, because it is. But no. Quite the opposite, actually.
lines.zh: : 很好,因为在。但是没有。实际上恰恰相反。

lines.en: : I’d be willing to tell you more about exactly what I intend to-
lines.zh: : 我本愿意告诉你更多我究竟打算——

lines.en: : No need. Just get him out of here. Handcuff him if you have to. Then let me keep the handcuffs. He keeps trying to hug me in his sleep and his touch currently makes me sick. Except for when it doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 不必。把他弄出去就好。必要的话铐上他。然后手铐留给我。他睡觉老想抱我,而现在他的触碰让我恶心。除了不让我恶心的时候。

lines.en: : Oh, I’ve heard about this before! The...tsundere, correct? You act distant, but deep down, you love him more than life itself.
lines.zh: : 哦,这个我听说过!那个……傲娇,对吧?你表现得疏远,但在内心深处,你爱他胜过爱命。

lines.en: : Right. But I’m also the childhood friend, so you forgot about the stereotype where I just get fucking shafted all the time.
lines.zh: : 对。但我同时也是青梅竹马,所以你忘了那个「我总他妈被踢出局」的老套。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but I assumed being shafted would be a good thing.
lines.zh: : 我如果记错了请纠正——我一直以为「被杵」是好事来着。

lines.en: : Hey, how come I don’t have a shadow?
lines.zh: : 嘿,我怎么没有影子?

lines.en: We’re in the car now.
lines.zh: 我们现在在车里。

lines.en: : Quite the character, that Niki girl. I can see why you two have been together for so long.
lines.zh: : 那位 Niki 姑娘,真是个妙人。难怪你们俩在一起这么久。

lines.en: : You...can? Really? But all she did was berate me and tell us to not have sex.
lines.zh: : 你……能?真的?可她做的就是骂我,然后叫我们别做爱。

lines.en: : Yes. Well, it’s that whole “opposites attract” concept. She’s strong. You’re weak. So the two of you have developed some sort of lovey-dovey yet fiery symbiosis. Tell me — the sex is fantastic, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是。嗯,就是那套「互补相吸」的概念。她强。你弱。所以你们俩发展出了某种如胶似漆又火药味十足的共生。告诉我——性爱很棒,对吧?

lines.en: : Amazing.
lines.zh: : 神奇地棒。

lines.en: : Better or worse than it is with my daughter?
lines.zh: : 和我女儿做,比这好还是差?

lines.en: : I haven’t had sex with your daughter.
lines.zh: : 我没和你女儿做过。

lines.en: : Oh, right. You just fingered her to completion in a residential alleyway. Silly me.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。你只是在一处住宅区小巷里把她手指到了终点。瞧我笨的。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Oh is right, you insatiable moron. I offer up my entire home to you to essentially do as you please with Touka, and you claim her in a public alleyway?
lines.zh: : 「哦」得好,你这个不知餍足的白痴。我把整个家都献给你,让你基本随意处置 Touka,你却在一条公共小巷里「认领」她?

lines.en: : I understand that recklessness is the name of your game, but if you’re going to put my family’s reputation in jeopardy, perhaps I should return you as a eunuch?
lines.zh: : 我明白鲁莽是你的游戏之道,但如果你要把我家族的声誉置于险境,也许我该把你以太监状态退货?

lines.en: : I knew I was in trouble and you told me I wasn’t. I had a feeling something like this was going to happen today.
lines.zh: : 我就知道自己有麻烦,而你告诉我没有。我早有预感,今天会发生这种事。

lines.en: : I don’t know if you’ve realized this yet, Akira, but I say a lot of things. And your intuition is normally correct, but you normally act against it anyway with extremely minimal effort on my behalf.
lines.zh: : 不知你意识到没有,Akira,我说的话很多。而你的直觉通常正确,但你通常照样违背它——而我在一旁只需极小的力气。

lines.en: : It makes me wonder if you’ve always been this easy to manipulate. Or what could be done to make you dance on my strings in even more extravagant fashion.
lines.zh: : 这让我好奇,你是否一直这么好操纵。又或者,还能做什么,让你在我的提线上舞得更华丽。

lines.en: : That’s enough intimidation, though! Congratulations! You’re one step closer to deflowering an heiress! Who’d have ever thought you’d make it this high up the ladder with just your cock alone?!
lines.zh: : 不过威吓到此为止!恭喜!你距离夺走一位女继承人的初夜又近了一步!谁会想到,光凭你那根玩意,你能爬到梯子的这个高度?!

lines.en: : I thought you said that was enough intimidation?
lines.zh: : 我以为你刚说威吓到此为止?

lines.en: : How many times do I need to say that sometimes I just say things before you understand that sometimes I just say things?
lines.zh: : 「我有时只是随口说说」这句话,我需要说多少遍,你才能明白我有时只是随口说说?

lines.en: : I do wonder what comes next, though. If only Touka had lasted a few seconds longer. I imagine she’d have returned home with the phantom sensations of you thrusting into her still going strong.
lines.zh: : 不过,我确实好奇接下来会怎样。要是 Touka 当时多撑几秒就好了。我猜她回家时,你顶弄她的幻肢余韵仍会劲道十足。

lines.en: : What do you mean “if only she lasted a few seconds longer?”
lines.zh: : 「要是她多撑几秒」是什么意思?

lines.en: : What do you think I mean? Do you think I was somehow listening in? Or that Touka told me about your little wager? Which Tsubasa do you think I am right now?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是什么意思?你觉得我当时不知怎的在偷听?还是 Touka 把你们的小赌约告诉了我?你觉得我现在是哪一种 Tsubasa?

lines.en: : The kind who is currently kidnapping me for reasons I still don’t fully understand apart from just teaching me a lesson. That sort of thing doesn’t take all day, though.
lines.zh: : 正在绑架我的那种——理由我仍不完全明白,只知是给我上一课。不过这种事不用花一整天。

lines.en: : Well, I suppose that all depends on what type of lesson it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我想那取决于上的是哪种课。
: 如果……

lines.en: : Tsubasa, if you’re talking about Tsukasa again-
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,你要是又要说 Tsukasa——

lines.en: : Would you like to hear about the type of man she’s to be married to, Akira? Or would you prefer she’s just shipped off and treated as someone else’s property that you no longer have to worry about?
lines.zh: : 你想听听她将要嫁的那种男人吗,Akira?还是你宁愿她被一船送走,当作别人的财产,你从此不必再操心?

lines.en: : Just fucking lie if you think that her suitor doesn’t want a girl who’s not a virgin. Don’t drag me into it.
lines.zh: : 你要是觉得她的追求者不会要一个不是处女的女孩,你他妈就撒谎啊。别把我拖下水。

lines.en: : Hell, just call the whole thing off if you have to. You betting Tsukasa’s entire future on the inclusion of some random commoner makes literally no sense and I don’t get how that’s still your move.
lines.zh: : 见鬼,实在不行就取消整件事。你把 Tsukasa 的整个未来,押在一个随机平民的纳入上,简直毫无道理,我不懂这怎么还是你的棋。

lines.en: : That’s just because you don’t understand the move. You’re not looking at the big picture.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为你不懂这步棋。你没有看大局。

lines.en: : Then show me. Give me an actual reason to break if you’re so desperate to dismantle what little of myself I still have some control over.
lines.zh: : 那就展示给我看。如果你那么急切地想拆掉我残存的、尚有一丝掌控的自我,就给我一个真正断裂的理由。

lines.en: : I intend to. That’s why you’ve been “kidnapped” and why you’ll be with me until nightfall. You’re welcome in advance, by the way. I wouldn’t do this for just anyone.
lines.zh: : 我正有此意。这就是你被「绑架」的原因,也是你要陪我到夜幕降临的原因。顺便,先谢过我吧。这种事,我可不是为谁都做的。

lines.en: : Do what?
lines.zh: : 做什么?

lines.en: : I tempt you with a surprise this great and you immediately ask me to spoil it for you? Have you no restraint at all, Akira?
lines.zh: : 我用这么大的惊喜吊你胃口,你却立刻让我剧透?你就没有一点克制吗,Akira?

lines.en: : I have some. It’s just weaker than the curious parts of me.
lines.zh: : 我有一点。只是比我好奇的那部分弱。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t want any part in doing something that weakens you. I need you just the way you are if you’re going to give my family what it needs when push comes to shove.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我可不想参与任何会削弱你的事。到了紧要关头,要你给我的家族提供所需之物的,是你本来的样子。

lines.en: : Right, yes. Sexual education lessons. The key to the Tsukioka Foundation’s future.
lines.zh: : 对,是。性教育课。Tsukioka 财团未来的钥匙。

lines.en: : Are you attempting to mock me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在试图嘲讽我吗?

lines.en: : I’m just pointing out how ridiculous all of this is. Tsukasa is Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 我只是想指出这一切有多荒谬。Tsukasa 就是 Tsukasa。

lines.en: : And Tsukasa is a sexually curious brat who’s already much more mentally mature than a handful of the girls you’re presently sleeping with. It’s not like I’m asking you to bed Chika’s sister. Bless her soul.
lines.zh: : 而 Tsukasa 是个性好奇心旺盛的小鬼,心智早已比你当下睡着的某些女孩成熟得多。我又没叫你上 Chika 的妹妹。愿她的灵魂安息。

lines.en: : You’re overestimating just how mature Tsukasa is. She’s still a kid at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 你高估了 Tsukasa 的成熟度。归根结底,她还是个孩子。

lines.en: : And so were you when you became a man. But now, you’re the most deeply loved person I have ever encountered.
lines.zh: : 你成为男人时也是孩子。但现在,你是我此生所遇见的被爱最深的人。

lines.en: : I’m a monster now, Tsubasa. And if that’s what you want your daughter to become, then maybe I can finally understand where you’re coming from.
lines.zh: : 我如今是个怪物,Tsubasa。如果那就是你想让你女儿变成的样子,那也许我终于能懂你的立场了。

lines.en: : Maybe it is?
lines.zh: : 也许正是?

lines.en: : Maybe turning her into a “monster” is precisely what will save her? It saved you, did it not?
lines.zh: : 也许把她变成「怪物」,恰恰是能拯救她的方法?它拯救了你,不是吗?

lines.en: : It did not.
lines.zh: : 它没有。

lines.en: : Then you’ve given up on achieving any sort of happy ending? Of reaching a future where everyone’s dreams can come true?
lines.zh: : 那你已经放弃了实现任何形式的圆满结局?放弃了抵达一个所有人梦想都能成真的未来?

lines.en: : What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你那么说是什么意思?

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 什么意思都没有。

lines.en: : You need to accept, Akira-
lines.zh: : 你需要接受,Akira——

lines.en: : That sometimes?
lines.zh: : 接受有时候?

lines.en: : I just have to say things.
lines.zh: : 我就是得说些话。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!

lines.en: : I don’t care what type of lesson it is. And I don’t care what sort of role you want me to play in Touka’s life.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎那是哪种课。我也不在乎你想让我在 Touka 的人生里扮演什么角色。

lines.en: : I just know that it’s different from what she wants. And that she hates you doing things like this even more than I do.
lines.zh: : 我只知道,那和她想要的不同。而且她恨你做这种事,比我恨得更甚。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Do you really hate it, Akira? Spending time with me like this?
lines.zh: : 你真的讨厌吗,Akira?像这样和我共度时光?

lines.en: : I came all the way to your house to see you. I nearly drank coffee from a communal pot. I apologized. And still you think I’m out to get you?
lines.zh: : 我千里迢迢来你家见你。我差点从公用的壶里喝了咖啡。我道了歉。而你仍然觉得我居心叵测?

lines.en: : What can I do to earn your trust? Your favor? In a way that does not separate me the way a woman like me begs to be separated.
lines.zh: : 我要怎么做才能赢得你的信任?你的好感?以一种不会把我隔离的方式——尽管我这样的女人,乞求的正是被隔离。

lines.en: : You’re just like Ami, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 你和 Ami 一个样,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t like incest that much. I just said I don’t automatically have a problem with it.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我没有那么喜欢乱伦。我只是说我不会自动对它有意见。

lines.en: : Not that. Just...the way you two are always saying one thing, then doing something else. I can never take your words seriously because I don’t know the intent behind them.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。只是……你们俩总是说一套,做另一套。我永远无法认真对待你的话,因为我不知道话语背后的意图。

lines.en: : I’m not good at reading people. I’m good at...hooking up with them. Making them like me. I don’t know how, but that’s all I can do. I can’t ever really get them.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长读人。我擅长的是……和人上床。让他们喜欢我。我不知道是怎么做到的,但我只会这些。我永远没法真正读懂他们。

lines.en: : So if you’re doing all of this stuff in hopes that something just clicks and I immediately understand what I need to do to make you and Touka happy, it’s not going to happen. I need you to tell me.
lines.zh: : 所以,如果你做这一切,是指望某个瞬间突然开窍、让我立刻明白该做什么才能让你和 Touka 幸福——那不会发生。我需要你亲口告诉我。

lines.en: : Akira, I apologize, but I can not spoon-feed you. I am not your mother. I am Touka’s mother. Tsukasa’s mother. And I will always put them first- even if it doesn’t seem like it.
lines.zh: : Akira,我道歉,但我不能喂你吃饭。我不是你的母亲。我是 Touka 的母亲。Tsukasa 的母亲。而我会永远把她们放在第一位——哪怕看起来不像。

lines.en: : Then what can I teach them that you can’t? What do I have at my disposal, huh? My body? Am I just a tool you can use to introduce them to the dark side of everything?
lines.zh: : 那我能教她们什么你教不了的?我手上还有什么可用之物,啊?我的身体?我只是一个用来领她们见识万事万物黑暗面的工具?

lines.en: : Yes. That’s precisely what you are. But your reasoning is off.
lines.zh: : 是。你恰恰就是那个工具。但你的推理偏了。

lines.en: : And just because you’re a tool doesn’t mean you aren’t indispensable. A surgeon is nothing without her scalpel. You wouldn’t want her carving into you with just her fingernails, would you?
lines.zh: : 而工具不代表可有可无。外科医生没了手术刀什么都不是。你总不希望她只用指甲给你开刀,对吧?

lines.en: : And you’re the surgeon here?
lines.zh: : 而这里的外科医生,是你?

lines.en: : If I were, would you let me reach inside your chest and hold your heart in my hands? I feel like it’s been alone for quite some time now.
lines.zh: : 如果我是,你会让我伸进你的胸膛,把你的心脏捧在手里吗?我觉得,它已经孤单了很久。

lines.en: : I’m too afraid you’d squeeze it until it erupts between your fingers.
lines.zh: : 我太怕你会把它捏爆,直到它在你指缝间迸开。

lines.en: : I’d never wash that hand again — and I’d wear the stains of your love on my flesh until death itself claims me.
lines.zh: : 那只手我永远不会再洗——而你的爱留下的污渍,我会穿在血肉之上,直到死亡本身前来认领我。

lines.en: : I want to go home, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我想回家,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : You don’t want to find out what’s waiting for you at the manor?
lines.zh: : 你不想知道,公馆里有什么在等你吗?

lines.en: : The manor is one thing.
lines.zh: : 公馆是一回事。

lines.en: : It’s what comes after that terrifies me.
lines.zh: : 之后的才是吓坏我的东西。

lines.en: EVENT CHAIN CANCELLED.
lines.zh: 事件链已取消。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection stagnates.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度停滞。
